parts.text: In this experiment, you will investigate the extension of a spring and use it to determine the weight of a metre rule. The spring has been set up for you. Carry out the following instructions.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Measure and record the unstretched length l 0 of the spring, as shown in Fig. 1.1. l 0 = .......................................................... cm Suspend the 1.0 N load from the spring, as shown in Fig. 1.2. Measure and record the stretched length l S of the spring. l S = .......................................................... cm [1]

ms.label: 1(a)
ms.text:
sensible value for l0
and lS > l0

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Suspend the metre rule from the spring using the hook fixed at the 95.0 cm mark, as shown in Fig. 1.3. Place the other end of the metre rule so that the 5.0 cm mark of the rule rests on the pivot. The metre rule must rest on the pivot at the 5.0 cm mark throughout the experiment. Place the load W on the metre rule with its centre at a distance d = 20.0 cm from the pivot. Ensure that the metre rule is horizontal by adjusting the clamp that holds the spring. Measure, and record in Table 1.1, the stretched length l of the spring, as shown in Fig. 1.3. Repeat this procedure for distances d = 30.0 cm, d = 40.0 cm, d = 50.0 cm and d = 60.0 cm from the pivot. Table 1.1 d / cm l / cm 20.0 30.0 40.0 50.0 60.0 [2]

ms.label: 1(b)
ms.text:
5 × l values increasing
all to the nearest mm.

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) Plot a graph of l / cm ( y -axis) against d / cm ( x -axis). Start the axes at the origin (0,0). 0 0 [4]

ms.label: 1(c)
ms.text:
graph:
•
axes labelled with quantity and unit
•
appropriate scales (occupying at least ½ grid)
•
plots all correct to ½ small square and precise plots
•
line well-judged and thin and extended to axis

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Calculate W R , the weight of the metre rule, using your value of L from (d)(i) , the values of l 0 and l S from (a) and the equation W R = 2( L – l 0 ) ( l S – l 0 ) × k where k = 1.0 N. W R = ......................................................... [1]

ms.label: 1(d)(ii)
ms.text: WR in range 0.9 to 2.1 and with unit of N

ms.label: 1(e)(i)
ms.text:
suspend load from loop of thread /
any other suitable method to avoid standing load over marks on rule

ms.label: 1(e)(ii)
ms.text:
valid source of uncertainty e.g.
test load not exactly 1.0 N /
spring extension not linear /
metre rule not uniform
